note: Hopkins County (TX) does not publish a zoning layer; Texas counties generally do not zone. The city of Sulphur Springs, the county seat, zones its land and shows zoning only in its MapGeo web viewer (sulphurspringstx.mapgeo.io), a vendor viewer with no public ArcGIS REST zoning service found. The ArcGIS Online item 'City of Sulphur Springs Map' (af19a675844f41f583b6214ef8fd686e) points to an Arkansas city's services, not Texas. The ATCOG open data hub search returned no zoning dataset. The city's zoning ordinance is a PDF and not a data layer.
